response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), totals AS (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_addresses_per_city, SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses FROM city_counts) SELECT cc.city_id, cc.address_count, cc.address_count / t.avg_addresses_per_city AS relative_to_average, cc.address_count / t.total_addresses AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts cc CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, cc.city_id LIMIT 10
